title: Input Time Tile
description: A time picker input. Compiles to AC 1.6 Input.Time.

id.description: Unique input id - the key under which the value is submitted to the host.

label.description: Human-readable label rendered above the input.

value.description: Initial time value in HH:mm format.

min.description: Inclusive lower time bound in HH:mm format.

max.description: Inclusive upper time bound in HH:mm format.
